metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:raw_dot_margin: Mean positive-minus-negative embedding dot-product score before transition evidence.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:raw_dot_margin_count: Number of scalar observations used for raw_dot_margin.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:complete_score_margin: Mean positive-minus-negative complete score using each training user's excluded-fold graph.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:complete_score_margin_coun: Number of scalar observations used for complete_score_margin.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:context_coverage: Mean recency-weighted share of context sources with retained outgoing edges in the user-excluding graph.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:context_coverage_count: Number of scalar observations used for context_coverage.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:positive_edge_coverage: Fraction of sampled positive targets with a retained edge from at least one recent context item.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:positive_edge_coverage_cou: Number of scalar observations used for positive_edge_coverage.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:absolute_residual: Mean absolute pooled transition residual before multiplication by the learned gate, across positive and negative candidates.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:absolute_residual_count: Number of scalar observations used for absolute_residual.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:deployment_training_residu: Mean absolute difference between deployment-average residual and user-excluding residual on sampled training positions; this is a training-side distribution-shift diagnostic.
Number of scalar observations used for deployment_training_residual_MAE.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:singleton_user_support_mar: Mean complete margin where the maximum distinct-other-user support among retained positive-target context edges is exactly one.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:multiple_user_support_marg: Mean complete margin where at least one retained positive-target context edge has support from two or more distinct other training users.
Number of scalar observations used for multiple_user_support_margin.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_cosine_mean: Mean cosine similarity of seed-42 sampled distinct nonpadding item pairs; alone this does not establish embedding collapse.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_cosine_std: Population standard deviation of the sampled pair cosine similarities.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:sampled_positions: Number of supervised positions measured from at most four batches and 512 positions per batch.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:unresolved_training_rows: Rows excluded because their exact sampled training history could not be assigned unambiguously to a user fold.
